title: extricating_young_gussie
author: Wodehouse
summary: Bertie Wooster is dispatched to New York by his formidable Aunt Agatha to stop his cousin Gussie from marrying a vaudeville performer, but the scheme backfires when Bertie summons Gussie's mother, who turns out to be a former vaudevillian herself and rekindles a romance with the girl's father, leaving both couples happily engaged and Bertie fleeing home in dismay.
